name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than generic upscalers, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality without extra compute. The trade-off is added latency—depth estimation slows the pipeline—but the quality gain outweighs the delay for most use cases.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers like InstantX-ComfyUI won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because they prioritize geometric accuracy over identity preservation—faces are high-frequency detail, not depth cues. RealVisXL 5.0’s face-preserving upscaler already locks EXCAVA into Anthropic’s stack, so swapping tools won’t break that dependency. To settle this, run a blind A/B test: compare InstantX’s output against RealVisXL’s face mode on 50 EXCAVA faces—if InstantX’s faces score worse in a user study, drop it.
